high_stakes.why: CI runs the gates, so a weakened workflow lets every later bad change merge unseen
The pre-commit hook runs the gates, so a weakened hook lets every later bad change commit unseen
The Definition of Done, so a weakened level passes every later bad change
The change review, so a weakened warning hides every later risky change
The only state changer, so a weakened one marks features passing without evidence
The command guard, so a weakened one lets agents skip hooks, force-push, or delete
Limits and run evidence the gates share, so a weakened limit relaxes every gate at once
Agent hooks and permissions, so a weakened one lets agents skip checks
The reviewer and evaluator, so a weakened one lets agents judge their own work
What the reviewer reports, so a deleted line lets a class of bug through every review
